rationale: Clear motor vehicle collision with damage to the policyholder's vehicle and the policyholder sustaining injuries from the impact.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday; the other vehicle struck at ~35 mph with no braking, causing total vehicle loss and injuring the policyholder (whiplash and sprained wrist). Police report filed with other driver's insurance information available.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision; other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Vehicle totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
